+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import yaml
+import markdown
+
+
+def build_site(source_dir: Path, output_dir: Path) -> list[str]:
+    if not source_dir.is_dir():
+        return []
+    written = []
+    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(source_dir, topdown=True):
+        # Skip directories starting with _ or .
+        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('_') and not d.startswith('.')]
+        for file in files:
+            if file.startswith('_') or file.startswith('.'):
+                continue
+            file_path = Path(root) / file
+            try:
+                rel_path = file_path.relative_to(source_dir)
+            except ValueError:
+                continue
+            if file_path.suffix == '.md':
+                try:
+                    with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
+                        content = f.read()
+                except Exception:
+                    continue
+                # Parse front matter
+                if content.startswith('---\n'):
+                    parts = content.split('---\n', 2)
+                    if len(parts) >= 3:
+                        front_matter = parts[1]
+                        markdown_content = parts[2]
+                        try:
+                            metadata = yaml.safe_load(front_matter)
+                        except Exception:
+                            metadata = {}
+                    else:
+                        metadata = {}
+                        markdown_content = content
+                else:
+                    metadata = {}
+                    markdown_content = content
+                # Convert markdown to HTML
+                try:
+                    html_content = markdown.markdown(markdown_content)
+                except Exception:
+                    html_content = markdown_content.replace('&', '&').replace('<', '<').replace('>', '>')
+                # Apply template
+                title = metadata.get('title', file_path.stem)
+                template = """<!DOCTYPE html>
+<html>
+<head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8">
+    <title>__TITLE__</title>
+</head>
+<body>
+    __CONTENT__
+</body>
+</html>"""
+                html_output = template.replace('__TITLE__', title).replace('__CONTENT__', html_content)
+                output_path = output_dir / rel_path.with_suffix('.html')
+                try:
+                    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+                    with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
+                        f.write(html_output)
+                    written.append(str(output_path))
+                except Exception:
+                    continue
+            else:
+                output_path = output_dir / rel_path
+                try:
+                    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+                    with open(file_path, 'rb') as f_in, open(output_path, 'wb') as f_out:
+                        f_out.write(f_in.read())
+                    written.append(str(output_path))
+                except Exception:
+                    continue
+    return sorted(written)
